newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Hartmann says talk of EMU delay "not good".
newsitem.headline: Buba's Hartmann says talk of EMU delay "not good".

text.p: Bundesbank council member Wendelin Hartmann said on Monday talk of a possible delay to European Economic and Monetary Union was not good and he expected EMU to start on time on January 1, 1999.
"I think discussions about a possible delay of currency union is not good," Hartmann said, departing from the text of a speech about the impact of monetary union on Germany as a financial centre.
"We think that EMU will indeed start on January 1 1999," Hartmann said.
Hartmann went on to say that talk of starting EMU without Germany was "academic and unrealistic".
Hartmann concentrated on the technicalities of the changeover period in the speech, and outlined the timetable for the transition to the euro.
